title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2024 Jerome Avenue, in Bronx, New York, as the "Dr. Roscoe C. Brown, Jr. Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2024 Jerome Avenue, in Bronx, New York, as the "Dr. Roscoe C. Brown, Jr. Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Bronx, New York Postal Service building after Dr. Roscoe C. Brown, Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2024 Jerome Avenue in the Bronx as the "Dr. Roscoe C. Brown, Jr. Post Office Building." It is an honorary name change and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, postal rules, and staffing stay the same.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 16, 2016.
